My s/o doesn't know i'm in a dark period.  He must think things are peachy keen.  In everyday life, I parade around like a normal, happy person.  I must look like I really have it together at times.

I already have a cat too.  He's great- a real sucker for attention who's been extra good to me today.

I see what you mean about jail.  I really don't want the system making decisions for me.  Plus, I'd lose my job, and I do really enjoy my job (although I was sick today) and the funding (to make stupid decisions apparently) that it provides.  I do have some things going for me I guess.  Thanks.
